verification.why_the_previous_block_was_deleted_rathe: VER-S11-040 recorded a command chain of `vitest run --project unit|component|release` and `playwright test --project=chromium`, with results of 6280/6280 unit, 3054/3054 component, 1000/1000 release, 548/548 e2e and 3/3 freshness. None of it could be true here: APP-020 (master prompt §2.3) deleted every test case in this project, `git ls-files` returns zero test files, and `package.json` declares no vitest, no playwright and no test script. It was slice-11 furniture -- `measured_by` named 2026-08-25, before this unit began -- and it survived three reseals on this branch (ece524f, d198800, 8688ff5) because each round treated the block as decoration rather than as a claim. The keys naming a test project (`unit`, `component`, `release`, `e2e`, `freshness`) have no honest counterpart in this repository, so they are gone rather than reworded to a smaller number.
